rows.text: Oh, so there is someone still willing to chat with this old coffin dodger... Ahem... When people get older, they can catch pneumonia just by having a sip of water. My aching aging throat...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Haha, they've already given me meds, so I'll just rest and recover...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Your body looks healthy. What's all this about...
I'm Battuta. I used to be a judge in the Klimt Republic. My side job was a travel writer... But now, I'm just a criminal waiting around for the Sky-Faring Commission to repatriate me...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Is it really strange for criminals waiting for repatriation by the Sky-Faring Commission to be waiting here? I'm Battuta. I used to be a judge in the Klimt Republic. My side hustle was a travel writer...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Just because you cared for an old criminal geezer like me, here's a piece of advice for ya — kid, don't spy on things you shouldn't know about. The water of Xianzhou runs deep, you won't be able to handle it...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Huh, still looking for the advice of a criminal?
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Hahaha... *cough*... I thought people nowadays are just a bunch of heartless savages... Let's talk, maybe you can learn something from my short life...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: What kind of country do you come from?
My homeland... The Klimt Republic is a great nation... *cough*... We have a vast territory, an efficient government, honest officials, and upstanding people...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: About a millennium has passed since its foundation... *cough*... We've already seen seventeen star systems, with a vast territory, and rich products... That's why our nation needs someone like me: A Judge.
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Many planets exist in ecological environments different from this one... And so the prime minister and council... ahem... That is, our government needs judges like me to help ratify laws and regulations tailored to each of the differing local conditions...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: *cough*... When I was 20, I graduated from the Royal Academy of Laws, becoming a Doctor of Law at 24... A year later, I passed the qualification examination to become a judge...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: I can still remember... The prime minister at the time, Madam Wiesener, awarding me my medal and encouraging me to dedicate my life to the people of the motherland, just like her...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Ahhh... How energized I was back then... The moment Madam Wiesener placed that medal on me, I felt like a carefree kid again — never to be tired again...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Hehe... That has twisted me into the kind of person I hate most, the kind who's loyal to their desires and gives no second thoughts to breaking the law...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: I used to be a travelog writer... *cough*... Before coming to Xianzhou, I'd traveled all over the cosmos, experiencing all the customs and peoples of different star systems.
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: I recorded these travel experiences in truth, put them into print, and immediately aroused enthusiastic responses...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: Actually, I have no misgivings... ahem... It's not due to any beautiful prose of mine, but rather because Klimt has always been like that... Any non-fiction writing is enough to rouse an impressed readership.
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: But all I've seen is still but a drop in the ocean... *cough*... My journey is not yet complete... But I will die soon with regrets... Am I greedy for longevity? Yes, but I'm greedier for the calling of a traveler.
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: ...It's over, it's all over.
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: And so you came to Luofu to experience longevity?
You really are a quick one, aren't you... But please, let me start at the beginning...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: I was still young back then, and brimming with exuberance... But Madam Wiesener shook her head and told me, "It's still early. Go to the human world, first."
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: And then I went to the "human world"... And saw the field hospitals on the frontlines lacking doctors and medicine. I saw the farmers in the desert struggling to survive. I saw that not every young girl out there got to experience "a fair life"...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: I made a lot of promises back in those days, and I've been fighting to keep them to this day... But then I woke up from a long dream only to discover that I could no longer walk...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: People are just like monkeys riding a unicycle while trying to juggle. While hurrying to catch those three balls up in the air, you still have to keep stepping on those pedals to spin the wheel and maintain balance...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: I'm old, and somewhat confused, but I remember every promise well... I'm afraid I'll never have time to fulfill them...
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: That's why I've come to Xianzhou, because I have to be here... This is the only place where I can fight the ravages of time.
rows.speaker: Battuta

rows.text: I should go...
Mmm, you go then. Don't waste your time here any longer with a criminal.
rows.speaker: Battuta
